ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High contrast ratio; approximately 45% high-intensity (white) pixels to 55% low-intensity (dark grey/black) pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Circular and elliptical white blobs of variable diameter (5-30px) distributed across both lobes; highest concentration of contiguous white pixels along the trailing edge of the left lobe; dark low-intensity vertical stripe at the median notch axis.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: V-shaped depression with a calculated internal pixel angle of approximately 65 degrees; depth measured from trailing edge baseline to apex is roughly 40 pixels.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Irregular, high-frequency peaks and valleys along the entire trailing edge; pixel amplitude of variations increases towards the tips due to calcified biological attachments (barnacles).
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Lobes exhibit a convex outer trajectory from notch to tip; distal tips show a distinct upward-sloping sweep relative to the central axis.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Numerous high-contrast circular rings (white outlines with dark centers) scattered across the mid-ventral field, particularly on the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Subtle, unaligned white linear pixel paths detected on the right lobe, approximately 20-40 pixels in length, oriented horizontally.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant calcified barnacle clusters (yellowish-brown high-contrast blobs) protruding from the trailing edge and tips, altering the 2D geometric contour.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly symmetrical circular ring pigmentation patterns not commonly found in standard mottled distributions.
